text: Past medical history: Obesity, type II diabetes mellitus, smoking history, hypertension. Social history: Drinks roughly ten beers per day. Recent travel history to Bangkok with unprotected sex.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Osteoarthritis.

Your X-rays confirm osteoarthritis in your hips and knees, and your normal uric acid level rules out gout as the primary cause of your pain. However, your history of heavy alcohol use and unprotected travel to Bangkok raises concerns for Hepatitis B or C, which can sometimes cause joint symptoms, so we should consider blood work for those viral infections.
